{{Top|leg}}
'''Insterstellar Credits''' were a common currency in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point. [[StarBank]] was an institution that exchanged local currencies for Insterstellar Credits.

==Behind the scenes==
It is unclear if this currency is meant to be the same as the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]].
